title: Boundary-Induced Apparent Risk Aversion in Nonergodic Multiplicative Growth
abstract: arXiv:2607.28230v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Finite multiplicative systems often cease to evolve when a lower continuation threshold is reached, whereas standard growth-optimal benchmarks assume uninterrupted continuation. We study a finite-horizon multiplicative process in which a fixed exposure is chosen ex ante and paths crossing an absorbing boundary are assigned a residual value. In the continuous-time limit the absorbed objective is available in closed form, and three results follow analytically. Costly absorption compresses exposure below the no-boundary Kelly fraction near the boundary; we prove that this holds strictly whenever the boundary is reachable within the horizon. The dependence on the horizon is non-monotone, and the optimum returns to a finite, cliff-independent long-horizon limit from below or from above according to an exact criterion, at which the threshold is the geometric mean of the residual value and the initial wealth, independently of drift and vola

translated_title: 非遍历乘性增长中由边界诱导的表观风险厌恶
translated_abstract: 有限乘性系统往往在触及较低的延续阈值时便停止演化，而标准的增长最优基准则假设过程可以无限延续。我们研究了一个有限期限的乘性过程：固定的敞口事先选定，而越过吸收边界的路径被赋予一个剩余价值。在连续时间极限下，带吸收的目标函数具有闭式表达，由此可解析地得到三个结果。第一，代价高昂的吸收会使敞口在边界附近被压缩至低于无边界的凯利分数；我们证明，只要边界在期限内可达，该结论便严格成立。第二，最优解对期限的依赖是非单调的。第三，依据一个精确判据，最优解从下方或上方回归到一个有限的、与悬崖位置无关的长期极限；在该极限处，阈值等于剩余价值与初始财富的几何平均，且与漂移率和波动率无关。
tldr: 该论文解析证明：当乘性增长过程存在可达的吸收边界时，最优敞口会严格低于凯利分数，这种“表观风险厌恶”完全由边界约束诱导产生，其对期限的依赖是非单调的，并在长期收敛于一个与悬崖位置无关的极限，此时阈值等于剩余价值与初始财富的几何平均。
en_tdlr: This paper analytically proves that an absorbing boundary in finite multiplicative growth strictly compresses optimal exposure below the Kelly fraction—an apparent risk aversion induced purely by the boundary—with non-monotone horizon dependence and a long-horizon limit where the threshold equals the geometric mean of residual value and initial wealth, independent of drift and volatility.
